chapters.summary: 5月清晨7点,一名伪装成英国皇家通信兵团通讯兵的杀手在圣日耳曼森林D98公路上从背后一枪打死SHAPE每周情报通讯兵Bates下士,抢走公文包、钱包和手表并伪装成抢劫。当晚在巴黎Fouquet's喝酒的邦德被F站女助理Mary Ann Russell紧急召回,站长Rattray通报案情并转达M的提示:注意总部里被人熟视无睹的隐形人。邦德在SHAPE向Schreiber上校了解案情无果,第3天从警犬管理员处得知森林空地曾有吉卜赛车队驻扎一冬、警犬总被其气味干扰,遂在空地边缘树干上发现伪装过的划痕,推断吉卜赛人是敌方留守间谍小组的掩护。第4天黎明邦德穿迷彩服潜伏树上,目睹玫瑰丛地堡开启、潜望镜式玫瑰花升起侦察、三名男子取出摩托车,首领穿通信兵制服准备再次截杀。当晚邦德说服Schreiber让他次日清晨冒充通讯兵跑同一路线,在杀手开枪时急刹转向,以.45柯尔特一枪击毙杀手,随后吹出口哨诱出地堡内两名同伙,在F站四名队员协助下生擒,结尾Mary Ann Russell持.22手枪救下邦德,两人相约次日晚餐。
chapters.summary_en: At seven o'clock on a May morning, a killer disguised as a Royal Corps of Signals dispatch-rider shoots Corporal Bates, SHAPE's weekly courier, in the back on the D98 road through the Forest of St Germain, and stages the murder as a robbery, taking his dispatch case, wallet and watch. That evening Bond, drinking at Fouquet's in Paris, is recalled by Station F assistant Mary Ann Russell; the head of station, Rattray, passes on M's hint to watch for the invisible man whom everyone overlooks. Bond learns nothing from Colonel Schreiber at SHAPE, but on the third day a dog handler tells him that a gipsy caravan spent the winter at the Carrefour Royal clearing and that its smell always confused the dogs. Bond finds camouflaged scratches on a tree trunk and concludes that the gipsies cover an enemy stay-behind unit. At dawn on the fourth day, camouflaged in a tree, he watches a bunker open in a rose-covered mound, a single rose rise like a periscope, and three men take out motorcycles, the leader dressed as a dispatch-rider. The next morning Bond rides the same route as a decoy and kills the gunman with his .45 Colt as he fires, then whistles the other two out of the bunker and takes them alive with four men from Station F. Mary Ann Russell saves his life with her .22 pistol, and they agree to dine the following evening.
chapters.title: FROM A VIEW TO A KILL

chapters.summary: 牙买加Content庄园,哈夫洛克上校夫妇拒绝出售祖传3个世纪的2万英亩庄园,哈瓦那来的Gonzales少校先出价50万美元现金,被拒后下令两名枪手当场枪杀夫妇二人,随后乘快艇逃往停泊在Port Antonio港的Chriscraft游艇返回哈瓦那。女儿Judy当晚回家发现尸体。约1个月后,10月伦敦,M向邦德坦言哈夫洛克是他1925年在马耳他婚礼上的伴郎,经卡斯特罗情报线查明幕后主使是前盖世太保、巴蒂斯塔反情报首脑von Hammerstein,其手下Gonzales在加勒比为其转移赃款购置地产;因无法引渡、M拒绝吊销签证,决定由邦德执行私刑。邦德经蒙特利尔、渥太华,在RCMP的Johns上校协助下化装成猎人徒步越境进入佛蒙特Echo Lake,在湖边草甸与同样前来复仇的Judy相遇——她已徒步4天、持弓箭潜伏一昼夜,此前小马被毒死、牧羊犬被枪杀并收到死亡威胁信。两人分工:Judy在Hammerstein跳水瞬间以钢箭射中其左肩胛,邦德以Savage步枪击毙两名枪手和Gonzales。Judy右臂中弹,邦德为她包扎后带她返回加拿大,约定去伦敦见M。
chapters.summary_en: At Content, a 20,000-acre Jamaican estate held by the Havelock family for nearly three centuries, Colonel Timothy Havelock and his wife refuse Major Gonzales's offer of $500,000 in cash for the property; Gonzales orders his two gunmen to shoot them both, then escapes by speedboat to a Chriscraft yacht at Port Antonio, bound for Havana. Their daughter Judy finds the bodies that evening. About a month later, in London in October, M tells Bond that Havelock was best man at his wedding in Malta in 1925, and that Castro's intelligence has identified the man behind the murders as von Hammerstein, ex-Gestapo and former head of Batista's Counter-Intelligence, with Gonzales moving his stolen money into Caribbean property. With no extradition and no witnesses, M orders Bond to carry out the killing himself. Bond flies by Comet to Montreal on a Friday, crosses into Canada via Ottawa with help from Colonel Johns of the RCMP, disguises himself as a hunter and walks across the border to Echo Lake, Vermont, where he meets Judy — she has walked four days and lain in wait a day and a night with her bow, after her pony was poisoned, her sheepdog shot and a death threat received. They divide the work: as Hammerstein dives, Judy puts a steel arrow into his left shoulder blade, and Bond shoots the two gunmen and Gonzales. Judy is wounded in the right arm; Bond dresses the wound and takes her back to Canada, with a promise to see M in London.
chapters.title: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

chapters.summary: 邦德在拿骚执行烧毁两艘向古巴卡斯特罗叛军运送武器的游艇任务后,出席总督晚宴。席间邦德随口说若结婚愿娶空姐,总督由此讲起旧同事Philip Masters的故事:性格腼腆的殖民地官员Masters在尼日利亚任职后乘帝国航空航班回国,爱上空姐Rhoda Llewellyn并结婚,调任百慕大后妻子沉迷高尔夫社交圈并与富商之子Tattersall公开出轨,被抛弃后想与丈夫和解;Masters回国述职归来后以极端冷漠报复——将住宅一分为二、一年内彼此不说话、每月只给20镑家用并着手离婚,临走前把分期未付清的Morris汽车和留声机留给妻子,实为债务陷阱,令她典当首饰仍负债。总督据此提出Quantum of Solace(慰藉量)定律:当伴侣间的基本人性关怀归零,关系即不可挽回。Masters此后仕途沉沦,最终退休回尼日利亚;罗达在百慕大几近沦落,经Burford夫人帮助到牙买加金斯敦Blue Hills酒店当接待员,最终嫁给加拿大富商Harvey Miller。结尾邦德发现当晚坐在身边的米勒夫人正是罗达本人。
chapters.summary_en: After burning two yachts in Nassau that were to carry arms to Castro's rebels in Cuba, Bond attends a dinner at Government House. Remarking that if he ever married he would marry an air hostess, he prompts the Governor to tell the story of his former colleague Philip Masters: a shy colonial officer who met Imperial Airways hostess Rhoda Llewellyn on a flight home from Nigeria and married her, then was posted to Bermuda, where Rhoda fell into the golf and social set and left him openly for the eldest Tattersall boy. When she tried to come back, Masters returned from leave and took revenge with icy precision — dividing the house in two, refusing to speak to her for a year, allowing her £20 a month and arranging a divorce, and leaving her a Morris car and a gramophone that were still on hire purchase, a debt trap that forced her to pawn her jewellery. From this the Governor derives his Law of the Quantum of Solace: once the basic human consideration between partners reaches zero, the relationship is beyond repair. Masters's career faded and he retired to Nigeria; Rhoda, helped by Mrs Burford, became a receptionist at the Blue Hills hotel in Kingston, Jamaica, and married the Canadian millionaire Harvey Miller — the woman sitting next to Bond at dinner.
chapters.title: QUANTUM OF SOLACE

chapters.summary: 海洛因大量流入英国,首相以心理战为由命M派邦德赴罗马。邦德在Excelsior酒吧与美国缉毒局线人Kristatos接头,当晚在Colomba d'Oro餐厅,Kristatos索价1万美元情报费加事成后2万美元,称走私网首脑是餐厅老板、有Dove之称的Enrico Colombo,并要求邦德杀掉此人;邦德未承诺。餐厅老板Colombo早已在邦德座椅垫中藏Grundig录音机窃听全程,随后安排女友Lisl Baum与邦德演一出争吵戏,引邦德送她回Hotel Ambassadori并约定两天后下午3点在威尼斯Lido的Bagni Alberoni沙丘见面。邦德赴威尼斯后遭三名杀手追杀,一人踩中沙丘旧地雷炸死,邦德被Colombo的鱼叉枪手截住并击晕,醒来已在Colombo的船Colombina号上。Colombo播放录音对质,自称二战时为英国抵抗组织工作并获国王勋章,承认自己是地中海最大走私贩(香烟、黄金、钻石)但从不碰毒品,指控Kristatos才是真正的毒枭:其毒品来自苏联高加索罂粟田,经阿尔巴尼亚中转,在那不勒斯制成海洛因。次日黎明Colombo率船突袭安科纳以北Santa Maria港的阿尔巴尼亚船,邦德击毙机枪手,发现仓库内新闻纸卷中藏有生鸦片,Kristatos引爆炸药后驾Lancia逃跑,被邦德三枪击毙。Colombo把Lisl Baum在Danielli酒店68号房的钥匙交给邦德作为谢礼。
chapters.summary_en: Heroin is flooding Britain, and on the Prime Minister's orders M sends Bond to Rome. In the Excelsior bar Bond meets Kristatos, the US Narcotics Bureau's informant, identified by a lone Alexandra cocktail; at the Colomba d'Oro restaurant that evening Kristatos demands $10,000 for his information and $20,000 on completion, names the restaurant's owner Enrico Colombo — "the Dove" — as the head of the network, and asks Bond to kill him. Bond promises nothing. Colombo has already hidden a Grundig tape recorder in Bond's chair cushion and heard everything; he stages a quarrel between his girlfriend Lisl Baum and Bond, so that Bond escorts her back to the Hotel Ambassadori and agrees to meet her at 3 p.m. two days later at the Bagni Alberoni dunes on the Venice Lido. There Bond is chased by three killers, one of whom steps on an old mine; Colombo's harpoon gunner cuts him off and knocks him out, and he wakes aboard Colombo's ship, the Colombina. Colombo plays back the tape and makes his case: he worked for the British Resistance in the war and holds the King's Medal; he is the Mediterranean's biggest smuggler — cigarettes, gold, diamonds — but never touches drugs, and Kristatos is the real drug chief, his opium coming from Soviet poppy fields in the Caucasus via Albania and made into heroin in Naples. At dawn the next day Colombo raids the Albanian ship at Santa Maria, north of Ancona; Bond kills the machine-gunner and finds raw opium hidden in rolls of newsprint in the warehouse; Kristatos sets off explosives and flees in a Lancia, and Bond shoots him dead. Colombo gives Bond the key to Lisl's room 68 at the Danielli as thanks.
chapters.title: RISICO

chapters.summary: 4月塞舌尔马埃岛Belle Anse泻湖,邦德用鱼叉猎杀一条6英尺魔鬼鱼。当地朋友Fidele Barbey邀他登上美国富豪Milton Krest的百英尺游艇Wawekrest,赴约1000英里外的Chagrin岛寻找1925年Hildebrand教授捕获的唯一标本、6英寸粉红黑纹松鼠鱼Hildebrand Rarity。Krest以Krest基金会避税,自称受Smithsonian委托采集标本,实以贿赂取得受保护的黑鹦鹉、巨龟和贝壳收藏。抵达Chagrin岛后邦德与Barbey沿礁搜索无果,Krest首次戴面罩下水竟先找到此鱼,随后用5加仑鱼藤酮毒杀整片礁区,邦德暗中先赶走目标鱼又取回一条被毒死的标本交给Krest。当晚Krest醉酒辱骂羞辱邦德、Barbey和妻子Liz,并以魔鬼鱼尾鞭Corrector威胁妻子,凌晨1点半左右Krest在船甲板吊床上被人把毒鱼塞入口中,鱼鳍棘刺卡住口腔窒息而死。邦德无法确定凶手是Liz还是Barbey,遂伪造吊床断裂坠海现场并把尸体抛入海中,次日编造失踪故事应付船员与警方,结尾Liz称要把毒鱼捐给大英博物馆,邦德答应随她乘游艇去蒙巴萨。
chapters.summary_en: In April, in the Belle Anse lagoon on Mahe in the Seychelles, Bond spears a six-foot sting-ray. His local friend Fidele Barbey invites him aboard the hundred-foot yacht Wawekrest, belonging to the American millionaire Milton Krest, for a voyage of about a thousand miles to Chagrin Island to find the Hildebrand Rarity, a six-inch pink-and-black squirrel fish of which only one specimen — caught by Professor Hildebrand in 1925 — has ever been recorded. Krest, who has put $10 million into the Krest Foundation to avoid tax and claims to be collecting for the Smithsonian, has in fact bribed his way to protected black parrots, giant tortoises and shell collections. At Chagrin the party searches the reef without success until Krest, wearing a mask for the first time, finds the fish himself; he then pours five gallons of rotenone over the reef, killing everything in it. Bond secretly drives the live fish away, then recovers a poisoned specimen to hand to Krest. That night a drunken Krest insults and humiliates Bond, Barbey and his wife Liz, and threatens her with the Corrector, a sting-ray tail whip. At about 1:30 a.m. Krest is found dead in his deck hammock, a poison fish stuffed into his mouth, its fin spines choking him. Bond cannot tell whether Liz or Barbey did it; he fakes a broken hammock and a fall overboard, throws the body into the sea, and invents a disappearance story for the crew and police. Liz says she will give the fish to the British Museum, and Bond agrees to sail with her to Mombasa.
chapters.title: THE HILDEBRAND RARITY

characters.appearance: 身材粗壮、面部线条粗硬带斯拉夫特征、黑眼睛、露大板牙的方嘴;穿皇家通信兵团制服,骑橄榄绿BSA M20
characters.appearance_en: Heavily built, with blunt, hard, vaguely Slav features, black eyes and a square mouth showing big teeth; he wears a Royal Corps of Signals uniform and rides an olive-green BSA M20.
characters.background: 敌方留守间谍小组首领,以吉卜赛车队为掩护在圣日耳曼森林地堡中潜伏一冬;邦德推测其上级为苏联军事情报机关GRU,原文未证实其姓名与国籍
characters.background_en: Leader of an enemy stay-behind spy unit, hidden in a bunker in the Forest of St Germain under cover of a gipsy caravan for a whole winter; Bond guesses that his controller is the Soviet military intelligence service, the GRU, but the text never confirms his name or nationality.
characters.habits: 随身带满弹Luger手枪,作案时用雪鞋避免留脚印
characters.habits_en: He carries a fully loaded Luger, and wears snowshoes when at work so as to leave no footprints.
characters.name_en: Unnamed leader of the stay-behind unit
characters.name_zh: 未具名的留守小组首领
characters.personality: 专业、谨慎,作案后清理轮胎印并取走钱包手表伪装抢劫,第二次作案前先以玫瑰潜望镜侦察
characters.personality_en: Professional and careful: after the murder he wipes out the tyre tracks and takes the wallet and watch to stage a robbery, and before the second attempt he reconnoitres with the rose periscope.
characters.story: 第1篇FROM A VIEW TO A KILL

characters.age_clues: 老年,与妻子结婚多年,女儿25岁
characters.age_clues_en: Elderly, married for many years, with a daughter aged 25.
characters.appearance: 未详述,蓝眼睛、抽烟斗
characters.appearance_en: Not described in detail, except for blue eyes and a pipe.
characters.background: Content庄园主,家族自克伦威尔时代起拥有该庄园近3个世纪;M在1925年马耳他婚礼上任其伴郎
characters.background_en: Owner of Content; his family has held the estate for nearly three centuries, since the time of Cromwell; M was best man at his wedding in Malta in 1925.
characters.habits: 看Daily Gleaner报纸
characters.habits_en: He reads the Daily Gleaner.
characters.personality: 坚定、厌恶美元,拒绝任何价格出售祖业
characters.personality_en: Resolute, with a distaste for dollars, refusing to sell the family estate at any price.

relationships.change: 一同被枪杀
死后女儿为其复仇

characters.appearance: 50多岁
characters.appearance_en: Over fifty.
characters.background: Content庄园女主人,嫁入哈夫洛克家后一直住在庄园
characters.background_en: Mistress of Content, who has lived on the estate since marrying into the Havelock family.
characters.habits: 在阳台喝下午茶、绣petit-point、观察蜂鸟
characters.habits_en: She takes afternoon tea on the veranda, does petit-point embroidery and watches the humming-birds.
characters.personality: 温和、爱鸟,痴迷两对蜂鸟
characters.personality_en: Gentle and fond of birds, devoted to two pairs of humming-birds.

relationships.change: 一同被枪杀

characters.age_clues: 25岁,出生于牙买加,持照上自报25岁
characters.age_clues_en: 25, born in Jamaica, the age she gave on her licence.
characters.appearance: 野性美丽,宽感性嘴唇、高颧骨、银灰色眼睛、淡金长发;穿破旧橄榄绿衬衫长裤,持弓箭筒,腰挂猎刀
characters.appearance_en: Wildly beautiful, with a wide, sensual mouth, high cheekbones, silver-grey eyes and long fair hair; she wears a worn olive-green shirt and trousers, carries a bow and quiver, and has a hunting knife at her belt.
characters.background: Content庄园继承人,父母被杀后赴哈瓦那赌场打探消息,经Pinkerton侦探社查到Hammerstein地址,徒步4天穿越绿山潜伏Echo Lake
characters.background_en: Heiress to Content; after her parents were murdered she went to Havana casinos to pick up information, traced Hammerstein's address through the Pinkerton agency, and walked four days through the Green Mountains to lie in wait at Echo Lake.
characters.habits: 擅长野外生存与弓箭,50码内百发百中,曾在100码外射落飞鸟
characters.habits_en: Skilled in fieldcraft and archery, deadly within fifty yards; she once brought down a bird in flight at a hundred yards.
characters.personality: 坚韧、独立、被仇恨驱使,起初对邦德充满戒备与敌意,事后变得温顺
characters.personality_en: Tough, independent and driven by hatred; at first full of suspicion and hostility towards Bond, afterwards she becomes gentle.

relationships.change: 初以弓箭威胁邦德,后结盟分工复仇,结尾随邦德去伦敦见M
为父复仇

characters.appearance: 约5英尺4英寸、拳击手肩臀、腹部发福,全身多毛但头脸无发,头骨亮黄白、后脑有凹陷,普鲁士军官式方面孔、猪眼、厚湿红唇,戴大金表
characters.appearance_en: About five feet four inches, with a boxer's shoulders and hips and a thickening belly, hairy all over except for head and face, a shining yellow-white skull with a dent at the back, a Prussian officer's square face, pig's eyes and thick, wet red lips, wearing a large gold watch.
characters.background: 前盖世太保,巴蒂斯塔政权反情报首脑,靠勒索敛财;被巴蒂斯塔解职后携Gonzales等3人逃往美国佛蒙特Echo Lake
characters.background_en: Ex-Gestapo, former head of Counter-Intelligence under Batista, who grew rich by blackmail; after Batista dismissed him he fled with Gonzales and three others to Echo Lake, Vermont.
characters.habits: 早餐后与枪手玩打酒瓶射击比赛,以赢得的女孩过夜为奖品
characters.habits_en: After breakfast he shoots at bottles with his gunmen, the prize being a girl for the night.
characters.personality: 残忍、好色、谨慎,出行有保镖持汤姆枪护卫,晨起做体操
characters.personality_en: Cruel, lecherous and careful, travelling with bodyguards carrying Tommy guns, and doing exercises first thing in the morning.

relationships.change: Gonzales为其转移赃款并执行谋杀,两人一同被杀

characters.appearance: 矮小、头发抹油、满口白牙、戴巴拿马帽,穿着讲究、指甲光亮
characters.appearance_en: Short, with oiled hair, a mouthful of white teeth and a Panama hat, well dressed, with polished nails.
characters.background: Hammerstein手下军官,为其在加勒比购置地产转移赃款,亲手带队枪杀哈夫洛克夫妇
characters.background_en: Hammerstein's officer, who buys Caribbean property for him to move his stolen money, and who personally led the men who shot the Havelocks.
characters.habits: 抽雪茄、随身带两名枪手
characters.habits_en: He smokes cigars and always travels with two gunmen.
characters.personality: 笑容可掬但翻脸极快,谈判先利诱后威胁
characters.personality_en: All smiles, but quick to turn threatening; in negotiation he tries bribery first, then threats.

relationships.change: 一同被邦德击毙

characters.appearance: 高大、年轻、穿深蓝西装白衬衫黑领带
characters.appearance_en: Tall, young, in a dark blue suit, white shirt and black tie.
characters.background: 加拿大皇家骑警人员,受局长指派单独协助邦德
characters.background_en: A Royal Canadian Mounted Police officer, assigned on his own by the Commissioner to help Bond.
characters.habits: 信奉局长格言Never send a man where you can send a bullet
characters.habits_en: He lives by his Commissioner's maxim: never send a man where you can send a bullet.
characters.personality: 谨慎、周到,二战时在蒙哥马利第八军服役,有狙击经验
characters.personality_en: Careful and thorough; he served with Montgomery's Eighth Army in the war and has experience as a sniper.

relationships.change: 为邦德提供武器、证件、地图与越境路线后分手

characters.age_clues: 老年,曾放弃升任第五海军大臣的机会接管秘密情报机构
characters.age_clues_en: Elderly; he once gave up the chance of becoming Fifth Sea Lord to take over the Secret Intelligence Service.
characters.appearance: 灰眼睛、抽烟斗
characters.appearance_en: Grey eyes, and a pipe.
characters.background: 英国秘密情报机构首脑;1925年在马耳他任哈夫洛克婚礼伴郎
characters.background_en: Head of the British Secret Intelligence Service; in 1925 he was best man at the Havelocks' wedding in Malta.
characters.habits: 用红色FOR YOUR EYES ONLY印章签署密令
characters.habits_en: He signs secret orders with the red FOR YOUR EYES ONLY stamp.
characters.personality: 在第2篇中为私谊所困,把是否处决Hammerstein的决定推给邦德;在第4篇中因被迫抽调人手办毒品案而暴躁
characters.personality_en: In Story 2 he is torn by personal feeling and leaves the decision to kill Hammerstein to Bond; in Story 4 he is bad-tempered at having men taken off other work for the drug case.

relationships.change: 第2篇把道德决断推给邦德,第4篇奉首相之命派邦德查毒品案

characters.story: 第2篇FOR YOUR EYES ONLY、第4篇RISICO

characters.age_clues_en: Elderly, with thirty years in the Colonial Service.
characters.appearance: 老年单身汉
characters.appearance_en: An elderly bachelor.
characters.background: 拿骚总督,殖民地文官,曾在百慕大任Masters的上司,先后任职特鲁西尔阿曼、背风群岛、英属圭亚那等地
characters.background_en: Governor of Nassau, a colonial civil servant who was once Masters's superior in Bermuda and has served in the Trucial Oman, the Leeward Islands and British Guiana, among other places.
characters.habits: 抽雪茄,讲故事时盯着烟灰
characters.habits_en: He smokes cigars and watches the ash while he tells his story.
characters.personality: 稳重、忠诚、能干、拘谨,提出Quantum of Solace定律
characters.personality_en: Steady, loyal, capable and reserved; he puts forward the Law of the Quantum of Solace.

relationships.change: 在百慕大共事并目睹其婚姻悲剧
由客套寒暄转为彻夜长谈

characters.age_clues: 与总督同龄,青年时入职
characters.age_clues_en: The same age as the Governor; he joined the service as a young man.
characters.appearance: 外貌平平、不修边幅,婚后曾梳发油、留军式小胡子,后恢复乱发、剃掉胡子
characters.appearance_en: Plain-looking and untidy; after his marriage he wore his hair with oil and grew a military moustache, then went back to untidy hair and shaved the moustache off.
characters.background: Fettes公学、牛津奖学金,殖民地部官员,先任尼日利亚、后调百慕大任政府助理秘书;父母在其读公学时分居;离婚后仕途沉沦,最终退休回尼日利亚
characters.background_en: Educated at Fettes and Oxford on a scholarship, a Colonial Office man who served first in Nigeria and then in Bermuda as Assistant Colonial Secretary; his parents separated while he was at public school; after the divorce his career faded and he retired to Nigeria.
characters.habits: 青年时打曲棍球、划船、登山;婚后为妻子戒烟戒酒、包揽家务
characters.habits_en: As a young man he played hockey, rowed and climbed; after his marriage he gave up smoking and drinking for his wife and did the housework.
characters.personality: 勤奋、善良、敏感、社交笨拙,婚前对异性毫无经验,被背叛后变得冷酷无情,报复手段极具算计
characters.personality_en: Hard-working, kind, sensitive and awkward in company, with no experience of women before his marriage; betrayed, he becomes cold and ruthless, and his revenge is carefully calculated.

relationships.change: 由热恋到妻子出轨,再到Masters以一年沉默分居与债务陷阱报复并离婚,终身未再婚

characters.age_clues_en: The same age as Masters; a young air hostess.
characters.appearance: 娇小匀称、牛奶玫瑰肤色、金发盘髻、樱桃红唇、蓝眼睛;在百慕大时常穿最短短裤、戴绿衬白遮阳帽打高尔夫
characters.appearance_en: Small and well-proportioned, with a milk-and-roses complexion, fair hair in a bun, cherry-red lips and blue eyes; in Bermuda she often played golf in the shortest shorts and a green-lined white sun hat.
characters.background: 威尔士血统,帝国航空空姐,与Masters在飞往伦敦航班上相识结婚;离婚后在百慕大潦倒,经Burford夫人帮助到牙买加金斯敦Blue Hills酒店当接待员,后嫁加拿大富商Harvey Miller
characters.background_en: Of Welsh blood, an Imperial Airways hostess who met Masters on a flight to London and married him; after the divorce she was left nearly destitute in Bermuda, was helped by Mrs Burford to a receptionist's job at the Blue Hills hotel in Kingston, Jamaica, and then married the Canadian millionaire Harvey Miller.
characters.habits: 婚前为帝国航空空姐,婚后沉迷高尔夫与社交
characters.habits_en: Before her marriage she was an Imperial Airways air hostess; after it she was absorbed in golf and social life.
characters.personality: 活泼、虚荣、追求刺激与上流社会,出轨后毫无悔意,被抛弃后又想重归旧好,最终靠美貌与运气翻身
characters.personality_en: Lively, vain, and hungry for excitement and high society; after the affair she shows no remorse, then, abandoned in turn, wants to go back to her husband, and in the end lands on her feet through her looks and her luck.

relationships.change: 由热恋到出轨、被报复离婚,最终各自另过
高尔夫混双夺冠后公开同居,后被Tattersall以父母断绝津贴为由抛弃
在金斯敦酒店相识并结婚,晚宴上坐在邦德身边

characters.appearance: 英俊、游泳健将、scratch高尔夫球手
characters.appearance_en: Handsome, a strong swimmer and a scratch golfer.
characters.background: 汉密尔顿最大商户Tattersall家长子,百慕大社交圈核心人物
characters.background_en: Eldest son of the biggest merchant in Hamilton, Tattersall's, and a leading figure in Bermuda society.
characters.habits: 开MG敞篷车与快艇,出入夜总会
characters.habits_en: He drives an MG convertible and a speedboat, and goes to nightclubs.
characters.personality: 风流、喜新厌旧
characters.personality_en: A philanderer who tires of his conquests quickly.

relationships.change: 混双夺冠后同居,后抛弃罗达

characters.appearance: 未详述
characters.appearance_en: Not described in detail.
characters.background: 加拿大百万富翁,冬季到访拿骚,晚宴客人;在牙买加金斯敦Blue Hills酒店结识罗达并娶她回加拿大
characters.background_en: A Canadian millionaire who spends the winter in Nassau and is a guest at the dinner; he met Rhoda at the Blue Hills hotel in Kingston, Jamaica, and took her back to Canada as his wife.
characters.habits: 早年投资天然气发家
characters.habits_en: He made his money early on by investing in natural gas.
characters.personality: 和气、略沉闷
characters.personality_en: Good-natured and slightly dull.

relationships.change: 结婚后生活幸福,晚宴上同席

characters.appearance: 高大、多毛、浓密棕色胡子、黑眼睛
characters.appearance_en: Tall and hairy, with a thick brown moustache and black eyes.
characters.background: 美国财政部缉毒局在意大利的头号线人,实为毒枭,毒品来自苏联高加索罂粟田,经阿尔巴尼亚中转,在那不勒斯制成海洛因销往英国;另做小规模走私作掩护
characters.background_en: The United States Treasury Narcotics Bureau's leading informant in Italy, in reality a drug chief whose drugs come from Soviet poppy fields in the Caucasus, pass through Albania and are made into heroin in Naples for sale in Britain; he also runs a small smuggling business as cover.
characters.habits: 接头暗号是独自喝一杯Alexandra鸡尾酒;爱吃甜瓜配火腿与巧克力冰淇淋,抽细黑雪茄
characters.habits_en: His recognition signal is a lone Alexandra cocktail; he likes melon with ham and chocolate ice cream, and smokes thin black cigars.
characters.personality: 谨慎多疑、贪婪,双面间谍,借美国缉毒局掩护经营毒网
characters.personality_en: Cautious, suspicious and greedy, a double agent who uses his American Narcotics Bureau cover to run his drug network.

relationships.change: Kristatos向邦德诬告Colombo为毒枭并索取其性命,后被Colombo与邦德联手揭穿并击毙
以情报换取邦德3万美元,最后在Santa Maria港被邦德击毙

characters.appearance: 肥胖、好享乐,穿着讲究
characters.appearance_en: Fat, pleasure-loving and well dressed.
characters.background: 地中海最大走私贩,走私香烟、黄金、钻石与药品,二战时为英国抵抗组织工作并获国王自由勋章;拥有米兰Pharmacia Colomba SA公司(只生产泻药与阿司匹林)与Colombina号船
characters.background_en: The biggest smuggler in the Mediterranean, dealing in cigarettes, gold, diamonds and medicines; he worked for the British Resistance in the war and holds the King's Medal; he owns the Milan firm Pharmacia Colomba SA (which makes only laxatives and aspirin) and the ship Colombina.
characters.habits: 经营Colomba d'Oro餐厅,爱吃意大利面,餐后抽雪茄
characters.habits_en: He runs the Colomba d'Oro restaurant, loves pasta, and smokes a cigar after meals.
characters.personality: 豪爽、贪吃、重义气、爱交朋友,自称从不碰毒品
characters.personality_en: Generous, greedy, loyal and fond of making friends; he says he never touches drugs.

relationships.change: 窃听邦德后设局俘获他,船上对质后结盟,联手摧毁毒网
安排Lisl接近邦德,结尾把她让给邦德
被Kristatos陷害,后借邦德之手除掉对方

characters.appearance: 维也纳姑娘,灰金色极短发、俏鼻子、宽大笑嘴、黑丝带绕颈,黑色比基尼
characters.appearance_en: A Viennese girl with very short grey-blonde hair, a pert nose, a wide smiling mouth and a black ribbon round her neck, in a black bikini.
characters.background: 维也纳人,Colombo的女友,住Hotel Ambassadori,次日去威尼斯
characters.background_en: Viennese, Colombo's girlfriend, staying at the Hotel Ambassadori, and going on to Venice the next day.
characters.habits: 每日下午在威尼斯Lido的Bagni Alberoni沙丘日光浴
characters.habits_en: Every afternoon she sunbathes on the dunes at the Bagni Alberoni on the Lido, Venice.
characters.personality: 活泼、大胆、机敏,配合Colombo演戏
characters.personality_en: Lively, bold and quick-witted, playing her part in Colombo's act.

relationships.change: 按Colombo安排接近邦德,结尾被Colombo让给邦德
由餐厅争吵戏相识,约定威尼斯见面,结尾邦德拿到她在Danielli酒店68号房的钥匙

characters.appearance: 50出头、坚韧精瘦、淡褐眼睛、嘴角下撇、头发黑灰相间如铁屑、右前臂纹鹰与锚、赤脚,说话带博加特式齿缝嘶音
characters.appearance_en: In his early fifties, tough and lean, with light brown eyes, a down-turned mouth, black-and-grey hair like iron filings, an eagle and anchor tattooed on his right forearm, barefoot, speaking with a Bogart-like lisp through his teeth.
characters.background: 美国Krest酒店集团老板,Krest基金会创始人,父亲为德国人(普鲁士人);以基金会避税,用200万美元造Wawekrest号游艇,自称受Smithsonian委托采集标本
characters.background_en: Owner of the American Krest hotel group and founder of the Krest Foundation; his father was German (Prussian); he avoids tax through the Foundation, built the Wawekrest with $2 million, and claims to collect specimens on behalf of the Smithsonian.
characters.habits: 午餐前喝3杯双份bullshot(伏特加加冰清汤),餐时喝啤酒;床头挂魔鬼鱼尾鞭Corrector惩罚妻子
characters.habits_en: Before lunch he drinks three double bullshots (vodka and iced consommé) and beer with his meals; the Corrector, a sting-ray tail whip, hangs by his bed for punishing his wife.
characters.personality: 粗鲁、好斗、虐待成性,以羞辱他人为乐,崇拜海明威式硬汉形象
characters.personality_en: Coarse, quarrelsome and sadistic, taking pleasure in humiliating others, and worshipping a Hemingway-style tough-man image.

relationships.change: 长期虐待妻子,结尾被毒鱼塞口窒息而死,凶手未明
雇Barbey带路寻鱼,整晚羞辱对方
整晚辱骂邦德,邦德忍而不发,结尾邦德为其伪造坠海现场

characters.appearance: 30岁上下、灰金长发披至颈部、大蓝眼睛、皮肤晒成古铜色,穿淡棕缎面比基尼;不涂口红、不染指甲
characters.appearance_en: About thirty, with long grey-blonde hair to her neck, large blue eyes and a sun-tanned skin, in a pale brown satin bikini; she wears no lipstick and no nail polish.
characters.background: 英国人,出生于新森林Ringwood,曾在Krest酒店当接待员,结婚2年,是Krest的第五任妻子
characters.background_en: English, born at Ringwood in the New Forest, formerly a receptionist at a Krest hotel, married two years, Krest's fifth wife.
characters.habits: 曾做模特与酒店接待员,喜欢猎户座腰带与南十字星
characters.habits_en: She was once a model and a hotel receptionist, and likes Orion's Belt and the Southern Cross.
characters.personality: 温顺、胆怯、渴望与人正常交谈,长期受虐后仍为丈夫辩护
characters.personality_en: Gentle, timid and longing for ordinary conversation, still defending her husband after years of abuse.

relationships.change: 长期受虐,丈夫死后她表现平静并称要把毒鱼捐给大英博物馆,是否为凶手原文未明言
夜里向邦德倾诉孤独,结尾邀邦德同乘游艇去蒙巴萨

characters.age_clues_en: The youngest generation of his family.
characters.appearance: 矮胖白人,穿卡其衬衫长裤,不带砍刀
characters.appearance_en: A short, fat white man in a khaki shirt and trousers, carrying no machete.
characters.background: Barbey家族成员,该家族拥有塞舌尔几乎所有产业,主营椰干;其叔叔Gaston有100多个私生子
characters.background_en: A member of the Barbey family, which owns almost everything in the Seychelles and deals chiefly in copra; his uncle Gaston has more than a hundred illegitimate children.
characters.habits: 潜水寻鱼,家中拥有塞舌尔大片产业
characters.habits_en: He dives to look for fish, and his family owns large properties in the Seychelles.
characters.personality: 开朗、好客、熟悉海洋,被Krest羞辱时保持克制
characters.personality_en: Cheerful, hospitable and at home in the sea, keeping his self-control when Krest humiliates him.

relationships.change: 邀邦德同行寻鱼,结尾一同面对Krest之死
被Krest整晚羞辱,是否为凶手原文未明言

characters.appearance: 未注明
characters.appearance_en: Not stated.
characters.background: 威特沃特斯兰德大学教授,1925年4月在Chagrin岛西南礁边3英尺水深处网获唯一一条Hildebrand Rarity标本
characters.background_en: A professor at the University of the Witwatersrand who in April 1925 netted the only specimen of the Hildebrand Rarity in three feet of water off the south-west reef of Chagrin Island.
characters.habits: 未注明
characters.habits_en: Not stated.
characters.personality: 未注明
characters.personality_en: Not stated.

communications.description_en: In Story 1, the SHAPE intelligence summaries, joint intelligence papers and Iron Curtain order of battle carried every Wednesday at 7 a.m. by motorcycle courier.
communications.name: SHAPE每周情报专递
communications.note: 第1篇每周三清晨7点摩托通讯兵运送SHAPE情报处摘要、联合情报文件与铁幕战斗序列

communications.description_en: In Story 1, M's highest-priority signal to the head of Station F, ordering him to find Bond at once.
communications.name: M的Most Immediate信号
communications.note: 第1篇M发给F站站长的最高优先级信号,命其立即找到邦德

communications.description_en: In Story 1 Rattray speaks to M on it; in Story 2 M speaks to the RCMP Commissioner; in Story 4 Bond speaks to London headquarters.
communications.name: 加密电话(scrambler)
communications.note: 第1篇Rattray与M通话;第2篇M与RCMP局长通话;第4篇邦德与伦敦总部通话

communications.description_en: In Story 1 Bond orders Mary Ann Russell to send his report to M in London on it.
communications.name: F站打印机(printer)
communications.note: 第1篇邦德命Mary Ann Russell把报告发往伦敦M处

communications.description_en: In Story 2 Judy pays the Pinkerton agency to find Hammerstein's address at Echo Lake.
communications.name: Pinkerton侦探社委托
communications.note: 第2篇Judy付费委托Pinkerton查到Hammerstein在Echo Lake的地址

communications.description_en: In Story 2, the letter Hammerstein's people send Judy: 'Death has many hands. One of these hands is now raised over you', demanding that she put 'I will obey. Judy' in the personal column of a newspaper.
communications.name: 威胁信
communications.note: 第2篇Hammerstein一方寄给Judy的信:Death has many hands. One of these hands is now raised over you,要求她在报纸个人栏登I will obey. Judy

communications.description_en: In Story 4 Colombo records Bond's talk with Kristatos on the Grundig tape recorder hidden in the chair cushion and plays it back in confrontation.
communications.name: 录音机窃听
communications.note: 第4篇Colombo用藏在椅垫中的Grundig录音机录下邦德与Kristatos的谈话并回放对质

communications.description_en: In Story 5 Krest uses the radio to tell the Smithsonian and the press agencies that he has found the Hildebrand Rarity; Bond uses it to report Krest's disappearance to Victoria harbour.
communications.name: 游艇无线电
communications.note: 第5篇Krest用无线电向Smithsonian与通讯社通报找到Hildebrand Rarity;邦德用无线电向维多利亚港报告Krest失踪

equipment.description_en: The killer's and the bunker unit leader's gun in Story 1; in Story 4 Colombo's men all carry Lugers.
equipment.note: 第1篇杀手与地堡小组首领配枪;第4篇Colombo手下人人配Luger

equipment.description_en: Bond's gun; in Story 2 he obtains a fresh permit for it in Ottawa, and in Story 4 it is taken from him during the chase in Venice and later returned by Colombo.
equipment.note: 邦德配枪,第2篇在渥太华补办持枪证,第4篇在威尼斯追杀中被夺、后由Colombo归还

equipment.description_en: The gun Bond hides inside his tunic when he poses as a courier in Story 1, killing the killer with a single shot.
equipment.note: 第1篇邦德冒充通讯兵时藏在上衣内的手枪,一枪击毙杀手

equipment.description_en: The light, large-bore lever-action rifle Colonel Johns lends Bond in Story 2, fitted with a Weatherby 6x62 scope, five-shot, firing high-velocity .250-3000 cartridges, effective to 500 yards.
equipment.note: 第2篇Johns上校借给邦德的轻型大口径杠杆步枪,配Weatherby 6x62瞄准镜,5发装、.250-3000高速弹,有效射程500码

equipment.description_en: Judy's weapon in Story 2, firing aluminium-feathered steel arrows; it kills Hammerstein.
equipment.note: 第2篇Judy的武器,铝羽钢箭,射杀Hammerstein

equipment.description_en: The double-rubber harpoon gun Bond uses to hunt the sting-ray in Story 5, fitted with a three-pronged tip.
equipment.note: 第5篇邦德猎魔鬼鱼用双橡筋鱼叉枪,配三叉针尖

equipment.description_en: The tape recorder Colombo hides in the cushion of Bond's chair in Story 4 to record his talk with Kristatos.
equipment.note: 第4篇Colombo藏在邦德座椅垫中窃听其与Kristatos谈话的录音机

equipment.description_en: The poison Krest pours — five gallons of it — over the Chagrin Island reef in Story 5 to catch the Hildebrand Rarity.
equipment.note: 第5篇Krest用5加仑鱼藤酮毒杀Chagrin岛礁区以捕捉Hildebrand Rarity

equipment.description_en: The Corrector in Story 5, the sting-ray tail whip hanging by Krest's bed, bought in Bahrain, used to beat his wife Liz.
equipment.note: 第5篇Krest床头所挂的Corrector,购自巴林,用于鞭打妻子Liz

events.cause: 敌方留守小组需截获SHAPE每周最高机密情报
events.cause_en: An enemy stay-behind unit needs to intercept SHAPE's weekly top-secret intelligence.
events.effect: 情报失窃,SHAPE与F站展开全面搜查无果,M派邦德调查
events.effect_en: The intelligence is stolen, and SHAPE and Station F search everywhere without result until M sends Bond to investigate.
events.title: Bates下士被杀

events.cause: 警犬受吉卜赛气味干扰与树干划痕引起邦德怀疑
events.cause_en: The dogs are confused by the gipsy smell and the scratches on a tree trunk arouse Bond's suspicion.
events.effect: 邦德确认吉卜赛车队为敌方地堡掩护,潜伏目击地堡运作
events.effect_en: Bond concludes that the gipsy caravan covers an enemy bunker, and watches the bunker at work from his hiding place in a tree.
events.title: 发现玫瑰地堡

events.cause: 邦德判断小组会再次截杀通讯兵
events.cause_en: Bond judges that the unit will try to kill the courier again.
events.effect: 杀手被击毙,两名同伙被擒,地堡暴露
events.effect_en: The killer is shot dead, his two accomplices are captured, and the bunker is exposed.
events.title: 替身诱杀

events.cause: 夫妇拒绝以50万美元出售Content庄园,Hammerstein下令灭口后向女儿施压
events.cause_en: The couple refuse to sell Content for $500,000, and Hammerstein orders them killed to put pressure on their daughter.
events.effect: 女儿Judy展开复仇,M命邦德执行私刑
events.effect_en: Their daughter Judy sets out to avenge them, and M orders Bond to carry out the killing.
events.title: 哈夫洛克夫妇被杀

events.cause: 无法引渡、无证人、Hoover只愿吊销签证,M不愿放过凶手
events.cause_en: There is no extradition and no witness, and Hoover will only cancel the men's visas, while M refuses to let the killers go.
events.effect: 邦德受命赴美执行无官方记录的处决
events.effect_en: Bond is ordered to go to America and carry out an execution with no official record.
events.title: M盖下FOR YOUR EYES ONLY印章
events.title_en: M Stamps FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

events.cause: Judy与邦德分别潜伏至湖边,Hammerstein跳水时暴露
events.cause_en: Judy and Bond have each lain in wait by the lake, and Hammerstein exposes himself as he dives.
events.effect: Hammerstein中箭落水,两名枪手与Gonzales被击毙,Judy负伤
events.effect_en: Hammerstein is struck by the arrow and falls into the water, the two gunmen and Gonzales are shot dead, and Judy is wounded.
events.title: Echo Lake复仇

events.cause: Masters在帝国航空航班上爱上空姐Rhoda Llewellyn
events.cause_en: Masters falls in love with Rhoda Llewellyn on an Imperial Airways flight.
events.effect: 两人结婚并调往百慕大,为后续出轨与报复埋下伏笔
events.effect_en: The two marry and move to Bermuda, setting up the affair and the revenge that follow.
events.title: Masters与空姐结婚

events.cause: 罗达沉迷百慕大高尔夫社交圈,结识富商之子Tattersall
events.cause_en: Rhoda becomes absorbed in Bermuda's golf and social set and meets the eldest Tattersall boy.
events.effect: 夫妻分居,罗达被抛弃后试图和解
events.effect_en: The couple separate, and Rhoda, abandoned in turn, tries to make it up with her husband.
events.title: 罗达出轨Tattersall

events.cause: Masters认定夫妻间慰藉量已归零
events.cause_en: Masters judges that the quantum of solace between husband and wife has reached zero.
events.effect: 一年沉默分居、离婚与债务陷阱,罗达一无所有,两人终身受创
events.effect_en: A year of silent separation, divorce and a debt trap leave Rhoda with nothing, and both are scarred for life.
events.title: Masters的冷漠报复

events.cause: Burford夫人资助她到牙买加酒店工作,结识加拿大富商Harvey Miller
events.cause_en: Mrs Burford helps her to a hotel job in Jamaica, where she meets the Canadian millionaire Harvey Miller.
events.effect: 罗达嫁入富家,晚宴上与邦德同席而不被认出
events.effect_en: Rhoda marries into wealth and sits at dinner beside Bond without being recognised.
events.title: 罗达再婚

events.cause: Kristatos需向美方交出大目标以掩护自己的毒网,并除掉知情太多的Colombo
events.cause_en: Kristatos needs to hand the Americans a big target to cover his own drug network, and to remove Colombo, who knows too much.
events.effect: 邦德一度把Colombo当作目标,Colombo窃听后设局反制
events.effect_en: Bond takes Colombo for his target at first, until Colombo, having recorded the talk, turns the tables on him.
events.title: Kristatos诬告Colombo

events.cause: Colombo派三名手下在Bagni Alberoni截捕邦德
events.cause_en: Colombo sends three of his men to seize Bond at the Bagni Alberoni.
events.effect: 一人踩中旧地雷炸死,邦德被俘至Colombina号,真相揭开
events.effect_en: One man is blown up by an old mine, and Bond is captured and taken aboard the Colombina, where the truth comes out.
events.title: Lido沙丘追杀
events.title_en: The Chase on the Lido Dunes

events.cause: Colombo掌握阿尔巴尼亚毒船卸货情报,率船黎明突袭
events.cause_en: Colombo knows when the Albanian drug ship will unload, and leads his ship in at dawn.
events.effect: 毒船沉没、仓库爆炸、Kristatos被邦德击毙,毒网摧毁
events.effect_en: The drug ship is sunk, the warehouse explodes, Kristatos is shot dead by Bond, and the network is destroyed.
events.title: Santa Maria港突袭

events.cause: Krest首次戴面罩下水,在礁区发现目标鱼
events.cause_en: Krest, wearing a mask for the first time, finds the fish on the reef.
events.effect: Krest以鱼藤酮毒杀整片礁区,邦德暗中放走活鱼又取回一条毒死标本
events.effect_en: Krest poisons the whole reef with rotenone, while Bond secretly drives the live fish away and recovers a poisoned specimen.
events.title: 找到Hildebrand Rarity

events.cause: Krest长期虐待妻子并整晚羞辱同行者,凶手身份原文未明言
events.cause_en: Krest has abused his wife for years and spent the evening humiliating his companions; the text never names the killer.
events.effect: 邦德伪造吊床断裂坠海现场,三人返港等待验尸,凶手成谜
events.effect_en: Bond fakes a broken hammock and a fall overboard, the three sail back to port to await the inquest, and the killer remains a mystery.
events.title: Krest被毒鱼塞口杀死
events.title_en: Krest Is Killed with the Poison Fish

facts.fact: Bates下士每周三清晨7点从SHAPE出发,沿N307转D98公路向F站运送情报,约12公里路程
facts.fact_en: Corporal Bates rode from SHAPE every Wednesday at 7 a.m., taking the N307 and then the D98 road to Station F — a run of about twelve kilometres.
facts.quote: Every Wednesday, at seven in the morning, a Special Services dispatch-rider leaves SHAPE
facts.quote_source: 第1篇FROM A VIEW TO A KILL
facts.timeline_position: 未注明年份,5月,周三清晨7点

facts.fact: Bates被Luger手枪从背后一枪击中,子弹切断脊髓,当场死亡,钱包、手表与公文包被抢走
facts.fact_en: Bates was shot in the back with a Luger; the bullet severed his spinal cord and killed him instantly, and his wallet, watch and dispatch case were taken.
facts.quote: Got the bullet. Luger. Severed the spinal cord.
facts.quote_source: 第1篇FROM A VIEW TO A KILL

facts.fact: 邦德在巴黎固定住Terminus Nord酒店,在Fouquet's喝Americano,在Harry's Bar喝烈酒
facts.fact_en: In Paris Bond regularly stayed at the Terminus Nord, drank Americanos at Fouquet's and strong drinks at Harry's Bar.
facts.quote: He stayed at the Terminus Nord, because he liked station hotels
facts.quote_source: 第1篇FROM A VIEW TO A KILL

facts.fact: Mary Ann Russell为F站二级助理,编号765,入职5年,在巴黎F站工作6个月
facts.fact_en: Mary Ann Russell was a Grade Two assistant at Station F, number 765, five years in the Service and six months at the Paris station.
facts.quote: From the Station. Grade two assistant. Number 765 on duty
facts.quote_source: 第1篇FROM A VIEW TO A KILL

facts.fact: Schreiber上校为SHAPE总部司令部安全处处长,美国人,全名G. A. Schreiber
facts.fact_en: Colonel G. A. Schreiber, an American, was Chief of Security, Headquarters Command, at SHAPE.
facts.quote: Colonel G. A. Schreiber, Chief of Security, Headquarters Command
facts.quote_source: 第1篇FROM A VIEW TO A KILL

facts.fact: 杀手小组以吉卜赛车队为掩护在圣日耳曼森林空地地堡中潜伏一冬,地堡入口藏于玫瑰丛土丘之下
facts.fact_en: The killer unit hid in a bunker beneath a rose-covered mound in a clearing in the Forest of St Germain, using a gipsy caravan as cover, and had been there most of the winter.
facts.quote: There was a gipsy caravan there for most of the winter.
facts.quote_source: 第1篇FROM A VIEW TO A KILL

facts.fact: 邦德用.45长管柯尔特手枪一枪击毙伪装成通讯兵的杀手,随后生擒地堡内两名同伙
facts.fact_en: Bond shot dead the killer disguised as a dispatch-rider with a single shot from his long-barrel .45 Colt, then took the two men in the bunker alive.
facts.quote: the Colt spoke its single word, and the killer and his BSA veered crazily off the road
facts.quote_source: 第1篇FROM A VIEW TO A KILL
facts.timeline_position: 未注明年份,5月,清晨7点后

facts.fact: Mary Ann Russell持.22目标手枪击毙扑向邦德的同伙,救下邦德性命
facts.fact_en: Mary Ann Russell shot dead the accomplice who lunged at Bond with her .22 target pistol, saving Bond's life.
facts.quote: One of the hands held what looked like a .22 target pistol.
facts.quote_source: 第1篇FROM A VIEW TO A KILL

facts.fact: Content庄园2万英亩,位于牙买加波特兰区Candlefly Peak山麓,家族自克伦威尔时代起拥有近3个世纪
facts.fact_en: Content was a 20,000-acre estate in the foothills of Candlefly Peak, Portland, Jamaica, held by the Havelock family for nearly three centuries, since the time of Cromwell.
facts.quote: Content, twenty thousand acres in the foothills of Candlefly Peak

facts.fact: Gonzales少校先出价50万美元现金(约18万英镑)购买Content庄园,被拒后下令枪杀哈夫洛克夫妇
facts.fact_en: Major Gonzales first offered $500,000 in cash (about £180,000) for Content; when refused, he ordered his two gunmen to shoot the Havelocks.
facts.quote: All hundred dollar bills. All genuine. Half a million dollars.

facts.fact: M在1925年马耳他婚礼上任哈夫洛克夫妇伴郎,此为其动用私人资源追查此案的原因
facts.fact_en: M had been best man at the Havelocks' wedding in Malta in 1925, which was why he used his own resources to pursue the case.
facts.quote: I was best man at their wedding. Malta. Nineteen-twenty-five.

facts.fact: von Hammerstein为前盖世太保,巴蒂斯塔政权反情报首脑,被解职后携Gonzales等3人逃往佛蒙特Echo Lake
facts.fact_en: Von Hammerstein was ex-Gestapo and had headed Batista's Counter-Intelligence; after being dismissed he fled with Gonzales and three others to Echo Lake, Vermont.
facts.quote: This one's ex-Gestapo. He got a job as head of Batista's Counter Intelligence.

facts.fact: Judy 25岁,出生于牙买加,持非居民狩猎与弓箭执照,签发地佛蒙特Bennington,费用18.5美元
facts.fact_en: Judy was 25, born in Jamaica, and held a non-resident hunting and archery licence issued at Bennington, Vermont, costing $18.50.
facts.quote: Judy Havelock had given her age as twenty-five and her place of birth as Jamaica.

facts.fact: Judy为复仇赴哈瓦那赌场打探消息,经Pinkerton侦探社查到Hammerstein地址,徒步4天穿越绿山潜伏Echo Lake
facts.fact_en: To avenge her parents Judy went to Havana casinos to pick up information, traced Hammerstein's address through the Pinkerton agency, and walked four days through the Green Mountains to lie in wait at Echo Lake.
facts.quote: I flew up to Bennington. Then I walked. Four days.

facts.fact: Johns上校借给邦德Savage 99F步枪,配Weatherby 6x62瞄准镜,5发装,有效射程500码,并提供走私路线手绘地图
facts.fact_en: Colonel Johns lent Bond a Savage 99F rifle with a Weatherby 6x62 scope, a five-shot repeater effective to 500 yards, and gave him a hand-drawn map of the smuggling route.
facts.quote: One of the new Savage 99Fs, Weatherby 6 x 62 'scope, five-shot repeater

facts.fact: Judy在Hammerstein跳水瞬间以钢箭射中其左肩胛,邦德随后击毙两名枪手与Gonzales
facts.fact_en: Judy shot Hammerstein in the left shoulder blade with a steel arrow as he dived, and Bond then shot dead the two gunmen and Gonzales.
facts.quote: A foot or so of steel shaft stuck up from below the left shoulder blade
facts.timeline_position: 未注明年份,10月,上午11点前后

facts.fact: 邦德配枪为Walther PPK,配Burns Martin枪套,在渥太华补办持枪证
facts.fact_en: Bond's gun was a Walther PPK in a Burns Martin holster; he obtained a fresh permit for it in Ottawa.
facts.quote: Walther PPK in a Burns Martin holster.

facts.fact: 邦德在拿骚烧毁两艘拟向古巴卡斯特罗叛军运送武器的游艇,方法为夜间从警艇上向舱口投掷铝热剂炸弹,无人员伤亡
facts.fact_en: In Nassau Bond burned two yachts that were to carry arms to Castro's rebels in Cuba, tossing a thermite bomb through an open port of each from a police launch at night; no one was hurt.
facts.quote: he had tossed a thermite bomb through an open port of each of them
facts.timeline_position: 未注明年份,拿骚任职期间

facts.fact: Philip Masters毕业于Fettes公学与牛津,先任尼日利亚殖民地官员,后调百慕大任政府助理秘书
facts.fact_en: Philip Masters was educated at Fettes and won a scholarship to Oxford; he served first as a colonial officer in Nigeria and later in Bermuda as Assistant Colonial Secretary.
facts.quote: He went to Fettes and took a scholarship for Oxford
facts.timeline_position: 故事跨越约20年,年份未注明

facts.fact: Rhoda Llewellyn为帝国航空空姐,在飞往伦敦航班上与Masters相识,1个月后辞职结婚
facts.fact_en: Rhoda Llewellyn was an Imperial Airways air hostess; she met Masters on a flight to London and resigned a month later to marry him.
facts.quote: A month later she resigned from Imperial Airways and they were married.
facts.timeline_position: 故事跨越约20年,年份未注明

facts.fact: 罗达在百慕大Mid-Ocean高尔夫俱乐部与富商之子Tattersall混双夺冠后公开出轨同居
facts.fact_en: In Bermuda Rhoda won the mixed doubles at the Mid-Ocean Golf Club with the eldest Tattersall boy and then openly left her husband to live with him.
facts.quote: She was partnered with the oldest Tattersall boy
facts.timeline_position: 故事跨越约20年,年份未注明

facts.fact: Masters以一年沉默分居报复妻子:住宅一分为二、彼此不说话、每月只给20镑家用、由律师办离婚
facts.fact_en: Masters took revenge with a year of silent separation: he divided the house in two, refused to speak to his wife, allowed her £20 a month, and had his solicitors arrange a divorce.
facts.quote: I have divided the house in two. Your rooms are the kitchen and your bedroom.
facts.timeline_position: 故事跨越约20年,年份未注明

facts.fact: Masters留给妻子的Morris汽车与留声机均为分期未付清之物,汽车尚欠200英镑,妻子典当首饰仅得40英镑、狐皮7英镑
facts.fact_en: The Morris car and the gramophone Masters left his wife were both bought on hire purchase; £200 was still owed on the car, and her jewellery fetched only £40 at pawn, her fox fur £7.
facts.quote: there's exactly two hundred pounds owing on the car.
facts.timeline_position: 故事跨越约20年,年份未注明

facts.fact: 总督提出Quantum of Solace定律:伴侣间基本人性关怀归零时关系即不可挽回,此为全篇标题来源
facts.fact_en: The Governor stated his Law of the Quantum of Solace: when the basic human consideration between partners falls to zero, the relationship cannot be saved — the source of the story's title.
facts.quote: I have called it the Law of the Quantum of Solace.
facts.timeline_position: 未注明年份,拿骚晚宴当晚

facts.fact: 罗达最终嫁给加拿大富商Harvey Miller,晚宴上坐在邦德身边的米勒夫人正是她本人
facts.fact_en: Rhoda eventually married the Canadian millionaire Harvey Miller; Mrs Miller sitting beside Bond at the dinner was Rhoda herself.
facts.quote: At the end of the time he took Rhoda Masters back to Canada and married her.
facts.timeline_position: 未注明年份,拿骚晚宴当晚

facts.fact: Masters离婚后仕途沉沦,最终退休回尼日利亚,终身未再婚
facts.fact_en: After the divorce Masters's career declined; he retired and went to live in Nigeria, and never married again.
facts.quote: he retired and went to live in Nigeria
facts.timeline_position: 故事跨越约20年,年份未注明

facts.fact: 首相以海洛因走私属心理战为由命M派邦德赴罗马,经费上限10万英镑,遇险可追加至20万英镑
facts.fact_en: On the Prime Minister's orders, on the grounds that the heroin traffic was psychological warfare, M sent Bond to Rome with up to £100,000 at his disposal, rising to £200,000 in an emergency.
facts.quote: A hundred thousand pounds. In any currency. That's the PM's figure.

facts.fact: Kristatos接头暗号为独自喝一杯Alexandra鸡尾酒,索价1万美元情报费加事成后2万美元,并要求邦德杀掉Colombo
facts.fact_en: Kristatos's recognition signal was a lone Alexandra cocktail; he demanded $10,000 in small notes for his information plus $20,000 on completion, and asked Bond to kill Colombo.
facts.quote: I wish for ten thousand dollars American, in paper of small sizes, by tomorrow lunchtime.

facts.fact: Kristatos诬称走私网以米兰Pharmacia Colomba SA公司为中转站,经东方快车卧铺、包机空乘与小船向英国运海洛因,藏于汽车备胎内
facts.fact_en: Kristatos falsely claimed the network used the Milan firm Pharmacia Colomba SA as a relay, moving heroin to Britain by Orient Express sleeper, chartered aircraft stewardesses and small boats, hidden in car spare wheels.
facts.quote: Always in the spare wheel. You can carry twenty thousand pounds worth of heroin in one spare wheel.

facts.fact: Colombo在邦德座椅垫中藏Grundig录音机窃听其与Kristatos的谈话,随后安排Lisl与邦德演争吵戏引其上钩
facts.fact_en: Colombo hid a Grundig tape recorder in the cushion of Bond's chair to record his talk with Kristatos, then staged a quarrel between Lisl and Bond to draw Bond in.
facts.quote: he unzipped one side of the cushion and withdrew a Grundig tape-recorder

facts.fact: Lisl Baum为维也纳人,住Hotel Ambassadori,约定在威尼斯Lido的Bagni Alberoni沙丘下午3点与邦德见面
facts.fact_en: Lisl Baum was Viennese, staying at the Hotel Ambassadori; she arranged to meet Bond at 3 p.m. at the Bagni Alberoni dunes on the Lido, Venice.
facts.quote: I bathe at the Bagni Alberoni, where the English poet Byron used to ride his horse.

facts.fact: 邦德在Lido沙丘遭三名杀手追杀,其中一人踩中旧地雷炸死,邦德被Colombo的鱼叉枪手截住击晕后带上Colombina号
facts.fact_en: On the Lido dunes Bond was chased by three killers; one was blown up by an old mine, and Bond was cut off by Colombo's harpoon gunner, knocked out and taken aboard the Colombina.
facts.quote: from the sand-dunes came the deep roar of an explosion.

facts.fact: Colombo二战时为英国抵抗组织工作并获国王自由勋章,自称地中海最大走私贩但从不碰毒品
facts.fact_en: Colombo had worked for the British in the Resistance during the war and held the King's Medal; he called himself the biggest smuggler in the Mediterranean but said he never touched drugs.
facts.quote: I worked for the English during the War. In the Resistance. I have the King's Medal.

facts.fact: 真正的毒枭为Kristatos本人:毒品来自苏联高加索罂粟田,经阿尔巴尼亚中转,在那不勒斯制成海洛因,一年量生鸦片价值约100万英镑
facts.fact_en: The real drug chief was Kristatos himself: the drugs came from Soviet poppy fields in the Caucasus, passed through Albania, and were made into heroin in Naples; a year's raw opium was worth about £1 million.
facts.quote: It comes from their poppy fields in the Caucasus, and Albania is a convenient entrepôt.

facts.fact: Kristatos在Santa Maria港仓库后引爆炸药后驾黑色Lancia Granturismo逃跑,被邦德三枪击毙于50码外
facts.fact_en: At the Santa Maria warehouse Kristatos set off explosives and fled in a black Lancia Granturismo; Bond shot him dead at fifty yards with three shots.
facts.quote: at fifty yards, the figure crouched over the wheel jerked backwards.

facts.fact: Colombo把Lisl在Danielli酒店68号房的钥匙交给邦德,作为联手摧毁毒网的谢礼
facts.fact_en: Colombo gave Bond the key to Lisl's room 68 at the Albergo Danielli as thanks for helping destroy the drug network.
facts.quote: The metal tag was inscribed Albergo Danielli. Room 68.

facts.fact: 邦德受命赴塞舌尔评估马尔代夫新基地受挫后改用塞舌尔的安全形势,报告结论为唯一隐患是当地姑娘的美貌与易得
facts.fact_en: Bond was sent to the Seychelles to assess its security as an alternative after the new Maldive base ran into trouble; his report concluded that the only conceivable security hazard was the beauty and ready availability of the Seychelloises.
facts.quote: the only conceivable security hazard in the Seychelles lay in the beauty and ready availability of the Seychelloises

facts.fact: Milton Krest向Krest基金会注资1000万美元避税,以200万美元建造Wawekrest号游艇,自称受Smithsonian委托采集标本
facts.fact_en: Milton Krest put $10 million into the Krest Foundation to avoid tax and built the Wawekrest for $2 million, claiming to collect specimens on behalf of the Smithsonian.
facts.quote: I put a matter of ten million dollars into the Krest Foundation

facts.fact: Wawekrest号长100英尺、宽21英尺、吃水6英尺,双500马力Superior柴油机,最高14节,8节巡航续航2500英里
facts.fact_en: The Wawekrest was 100 feet long, 21 feet broad, drawing 6 feet, with twin 500 hp Superior diesels, a top speed of 14 knots and a cruising range of 2,500 miles at 8 knots.
facts.quote: Hundred feet long, twenty-one broad, and draws six.

facts.fact: Hildebrand Rarity由威特沃特斯兰德大学Hildebrand教授于1925年4月在Chagrin岛西南礁边3英尺水深处网获,为世上唯一标本
facts.fact_en: The Hildebrand Rarity was netted by Professor Hildebrand of the University of the Witwatersrand in April 1925 in three feet of water off the south-west reef of Chagrin Island — the only specimen in the world.
facts.quote: Caught by Professor Hildebrand of the University of the Witwatersrand in a net off Chagrin Island

facts.fact: Krest以5加仑鱼藤酮毒杀Chagrin岛整片礁区以捕捉6英寸目标鱼,造成大量鱼类、龙虾、章鱼与海胆死亡
facts.fact_en: Krest poisoned the whole reef at Chagrin Island with five gallons of rotenone to catch the six-inch fish, killing large numbers of fish, lobsters, octopuses and sea urchins.
facts.quote: Just pour it in the water, where it'll float over what you're after

facts.fact: Liz Krest为Krest的第五任妻子,结婚2年,英国人,出生于新森林Ringwood,曾在Krest酒店当接待员
facts.fact_en: Liz Krest was Krest's fifth wife, married two years, English, born at Ringwood in the New Forest, formerly a receptionist at a Krest hotel.
facts.quote: Fellers, this is Mrs Krest. The fifth Mrs Krest.

facts.fact: Krest床头挂魔鬼鱼尾鞭Corrector,购自巴林,自称只对妻子用过一鞭
facts.fact_en: The Corrector, a sting-ray tail whip bought in Bahrain, hung by Krest's bed; he claimed he had used no more than one stroke at a time on Liz so far.
facts.quote: Haven't had to use more than one stroke at a time on Liz so far.

facts.fact: Krest被人把Hildebrand Rarity塞入口中,鱼鳍棘刺卡住口腔窒息而死,凶手为Liz还是Barbey原文未明言
facts.fact_en: Krest was killed by having a Hildebrand Rarity stuffed into his mouth, its fin spines lodging in his mouth and choking him; the text never states whether Liz or Barbey did it.
facts.quote: It was not Mr Krest's tongue that protruded from his gaping mouth. It was the tail of a fish.

facts.fact: 邦德伪造Krest坠海现场:弄断吊床绳索、清理血迹与福尔马林液滴、把尸体抛入海中,次日编造失踪故事
facts.fact_en: Bond faked Krest's fall overboard: he frayed and broke a hammock cord, cleaned up blood and formalin drops, and threw the body into the sea, inventing a disappearance story the next day.
facts.quote: he carefully frayed and then broke one of the main cords of the hammock

facts.fact: 结尾Liz称要把Hildebrand Rarity捐给大英博物馆而非寄往Smithsonian,邦德答应随她乘游艇去蒙巴萨
facts.fact_en: At the end Liz said she would give the Hildebrand Rarity to the British Museum rather than send it to the Smithsonian, and Bond agreed to travel with her by yacht to Mombasa.
facts.quote: I've decided to give it to the British Museum.

facts.fact: 邦德推测地堡小组上级为苏联军事情报机关GRU,原文未证实小组国籍与上级身份
facts.fact_en: Bond guessed the bunker unit's controller was the Soviet military intelligence service, the GRU; the text never confirms the unit's nationality or its controller.
facts.quote: off would go the high-speed cipher groups
facts.quote_source: 第1篇FROM A VIEW TO A KILL

facts.fact: 邦德怀疑凶手为Liz或Barbey之一,但两人均未露出破绽,原文未揭示真相
facts.fact_en: Bond suspected the killer was Liz or Barbey, but neither gave anything away, and the text never reveals the truth.
facts.quote: Which of the two had done this?

locations.role: 第1篇邦德休假地与F站驻地,含Fouquet's、Harry's Bar、Terminus Nord等邦德常去地址

locations.description_en: The scene of the murder and the bunker in Story 1, on the D98 road and at the Carrefour Royal clearing.
locations.role: 第1篇谋杀与地堡所在地,D98公路与Carrefour Royal空地

locations.description_en: The NATO headquarters beside the N184 road in Story 1, where the courier sets out.
locations.name_zh: 欧洲盟军最高司令部总部
locations.role: 第1篇位于N184公路旁的北约总部,通讯兵出发地

locations.description_en: The Havelock family's 20,000-acre estate in Story 2, in the foothills of Candlefly Peak, Portland, where the couple are shot dead.
locations.role: 第2篇哈夫洛克家族2万英亩庄园,位于波特兰区Candlefly Peak山麓,夫妇在此被枪杀

locations.description_en: The banana port in Story 2 from which the killers escape by speedboat to their yacht.
locations.role: 第2篇凶手乘快艇逃往游艇的香蕉港

locations.description_en: A millionaire's ranch in northern Vermont, near the Canadian border, in Story 2 — Hammerstein's hiding place and the scene of his death.
locations.role: 第2篇佛蒙特北部近加拿大边境的百万富翁牧场,Hammerstein藏身与被杀地

locations.description_en: The home of RCMP headquarters in Story 2, where Colonel Johns helps Bond.
locations.role: 第2篇RCMP总部所在地,Johns上校在此协助邦德

locations.description_en: The scene of the Government House dinner and the story-telling in Story 3; Bond stays at the British Colonial hotel.
locations.role: 第3篇总督府晚宴与讲故事地,邦德下榻British Colonial酒店

locations.description_en: Where the Masterses live after their marriage in Story 3, including Hamilton and the Mid-Ocean Golf Club.
locations.role: 第3篇Masters夫妇婚后生活地,含汉密尔顿与Mid-Ocean高尔夫俱乐部

locations.description_en: Where Bond meets Kristatos in Story 4, including the Excelsior bar and the Colomba d'Oro restaurant.
locations.role: 第4篇邦德与Kristatos接头地,含Excelsior酒吧与Colomba d'Oro餐厅

locations.description_en: Where Bond stays at the Gritti Palace in Story 4, and meets Lisl at the Bagni Alberoni on the Lido before being chased.
locations.role: 第4篇邦德下榻Gritti Palace,在Lido的Bagni Alberoni与Lisl会面并遭追杀

locations.description_en: The small fishing port north of Ancona in Story 4, where the Albanian drug ship unloads and the final fight takes place.
locations.role: 第4篇安科纳以北小渔港,阿尔巴尼亚毒船卸货地与决战地

locations.description_en: The main island of the Seychelles in Story 5, where Bond stays about a month, including Victoria harbour and the Belle Anse lagoon.
locations.role: 第5篇邦德驻留约1个月的塞舌尔主岛,含维多利亚港与Belle Anse泻湖

locations.description_en: A coral island of about twenty acres in Story 5, the only home of the Hildebrand Rarity and the reef Krest poisons.
locations.role: 第5篇约20英亩珊瑚岛,Hildebrand Rarity唯一产地,Krest毒杀礁区之地

mission.investigation: 第1篇:邦德走访SHAPE安全处、警犬管理员与圣日耳曼宪兵队,从吉卜赛车队气味干扰警犬与树干伪装划痕推断地堡位置,树上潜伏目击地堡开启。第2篇:M经卡斯特罗情报线与FBI局长Hoover查明凶手去向,RCMP航拍Echo Lake并提供越境路线,邦德徒步潜入后与Judy结盟。第3篇:总督口述Masters夫妇往事,邦德为听众。第4篇:邦德先信Kristatos的情报,后被Colombo俘获并对质,方知Kristatos为真正毒枭,随Colombo突袭毒船。第5篇:无调查,邦德随Krest出海寻鱼并目睹毒杀礁区,事后伪造Krest坠海现场。
key_clues: 第1篇:树干上伪装过的划痕,高度与搬运自行车时脚踏刮擦位置相符
第1篇:警犬在Carrefour Royal空地总被吉卜赛气味干扰,吉卜赛车队已于上月悄然离去
第1篇:玫瑰丛中升起带玻璃镜头的单枝玫瑰潜望镜,地堡如复活节彩蛋般开启
第2篇:Judy的弓箭与非居民狩猎执照,签发地Bennington、姓名Judy Havelock、年龄25岁
第2篇:M的红色FOR YOUR EYES ONLY印章密令
第3篇:晚宴上米勒夫人的身份,总督结尾点破她就是罗达本人
第4篇:椅垫中的Grundig录音机,Colombo以此掌握邦德与Kristatos的全部谈话
第4篇:Santa Maria港仓库内新闻纸卷中漏出的黑色生鸦片,气味与邦德在墨西哥闻过的一致
第5篇:床头挂着的魔鬼鱼尾鞭Corrector,揭示Krest虐待妻子
第5篇:标本罐塑料盖被取下、甲板上血迹与福尔马林液滴,揭示Krest死于他杀而非坠海
mission.objective: 第1篇:查明SHAPE情报通讯兵被杀案,追回失窃的最高机密情报并揪出内奸。第2篇:M命邦德以私刑处决杀害其友人哈夫洛克夫妇的von Hammerstein一伙,因无法引渡、无证人。第3篇:无任务,邦德在拿骚执行烧毁运往古巴的武器船后出席总督晚宴,听总督讲故事。第4篇:奉首相之命摧毁向英国输入海洛因的走私网,经费上限10万英镑,遇险可追加至20万英镑。第5篇:邦德受命赴塞舌尔独立评估当地安全形势(为马尔代夫基地受挫后的备选),报告已完成;寻鱼之行为私人受邀,非任务。
mission.outcome: 第1篇:杀手被邦德击毙,两名同伙被生擒,地堡待SHAPE防爆人员检查,邦德与Mary Ann Russell约会。第2篇:Hammerstein被Judy钢箭射杀,两名枪手与Gonzales被邦德击毙,Judy右臂中弹后由邦德包扎并带往加拿大、伦敦见M。第3篇:故事讲完,邦德向总督致谢并反省自己对普通人的忽视。第4篇:Kristatos被击毙,一年量生鸦片被焚毁,毒网摧毁,Colombo把Lisl在Danielli酒店68号房的钥匙交给邦德。第5篇:Hildebrand Rarity标本被取回,Krest被人以毒鱼塞口杀死,邦德伪造坠海事故,三人返抵维多利亚港等待验尸,邦德答应随Liz去蒙巴萨。

mission_en.investigation_en: Story 1: Bond visits SHAPE security, the dog handler and the St Germain gendarmerie, and infers the bunker's position from the gipsy smell confusing the dogs and the camouflaged scratches on a tree trunk; he watches the bunker work from a tree. Story 2: M traces the killers through Castro's intelligence and FBI Director Hoover, the RCMP photographs Echo Lake from the air and supplies the crossing route, and Bond walks in on foot and joins forces with Judy. Story 3: the Governor tells the story of the Masterses aloud; Bond is the listener. Story 4: Bond first trusts Kristatos's information, is then captured by Colombo and confronted with the tape, and only then learns that Kristatos is the real drug chief; he joins Colombo's raid on the drug ship. Story 5: no investigation — Bond sails with Krest to look for the fish and witnesses the poisoning of the reef, then fakes the scene of Krest's fall overboard.
key_clues_en: Story 1: camouflaged scratches on a tree trunk, at the height where a bicycle pedal would scrape while a machine was carried past.
Story 1: the dogs were always confused by the gipsy smell at the Carrefour Royal clearing, and the gipsy caravan had quietly left the month before.
Story 1: a single rose with a glass lens rose from the rose bushes like a periscope, and the bunker opened like an Easter egg.
Story 2: Judy's bow and non-resident hunting licence, issued at Bennington, in the name of Judy Havelock, age 25.
Story 2: M's red FOR YOUR EYES ONLY stamp on the secret order.
Story 3: the identity of Mrs Miller at the dinner — the Governor reveals at the end that she is Rhoda herself.
Story 4: the Grundig tape recorder in the chair cushion, by which Colombo learned everything Bond and Kristatos said.
Story 4: black raw opium leaking from rolls of newsprint in the Santa Maria warehouse, its smell the same as Bond had known in Mexico.
Story 5: the sting-ray tail whip, the Corrector, hanging by the bed, revealing Krest's abuse of his wife.
Story 5: the specimen jar's plastic lid removed, and blood and drops of formalin on the deck, revealing that Krest was murdered rather than falling overboard.
mission_en.objective_en: Story 1: find who killed SHAPE's weekly courier, recover the stolen top-secret material and expose the insider. Story 2: on M's orders, execute von Hammerstein and his men for murdering his friends the Havelocks, since extradition is impossible and there are no witnesses. Story 3: no mission — after burning the arms yachts in Nassau, Bond attends the Governor's dinner and listens to his story. Story 4: on the Prime Minister's orders, destroy the heroin network supplying Britain, with up to £100,000 to spend, rising to £200,000 in an emergency. Story 5: Bond is in the Seychelles to assess its security as an alternative base after the Maldive project faltered; his report is finished, and the fishing trip is a private invitation, not a mission.
mission_en.outcome_en: Story 1: the killer is shot dead by Bond, his two accomplices are taken alive, and the bunker is left for SHAPE's anti-sabotage men to examine; Bond has his dinner date with Mary Ann Russell. Story 2: Hammerstein is killed by Judy's steel arrow, the two gunmen and Gonzales are shot dead by Bond, and Judy, wounded in the right arm, is bandaged by Bond and taken to Canada and on to see M in London. Story 3: the story ends, Bond thanks the Governor and reflects on how little attention he pays to ordinary people. Story 4: Kristatos is shot dead, a year's raw opium is burned, the drug network is destroyed, and Colombo gives Bond the key to Lisl's room 68 at the Danielli. Story 5: the Hildebrand Rarity specimen is recovered, Krest is found killed by a poison fish stuffed into his mouth, Bond fakes a fall overboard, and the three sail back to Victoria to await the inquest, Bond having agreed to go on to Mombasa with Liz.

organizations.description_en: Bond's own service; Station F in Paris is its French station in Story 1, in Story 2 M uses its resources in his own name to avenge his friend, and in Story 4 it investigates the drug case on the Prime Minister's orders.
organizations.role: 邦德所属机构;第1篇F站为其巴黎外站,第2篇M以个人名义动用其资源为友复仇,第4篇奉首相之命调查毒品案

organizations.description_en: The scene of the crime in Story 1; every Wednesday morning its weekly top-secret intelligence leaves for Station F, and its security is Colonel Schreiber's responsibility.
organizations.role: 第1篇案发地,每周三清晨向F站运送最高机密情报的出发地,其安全处由Schreiber上校负责

organizations.description_en: In Story 1, the controlling organisation Bond guesses lies behind the bunker unit; the text offers it only as a guess, never confirmed.
organizations.role: 第1篇邦德推测地堡小组的上级控制机关,原文仅为推测未证实

organizations.description_en: In Story 2 it helps Bond cross the border, supplying weapons, papers, maps and the smuggling route, and photographs Echo Lake from a reconnaissance aircraft.
organizations.role: 第2篇协助邦德越境,提供武器、证件、地图与走私路线,并以侦察机航拍Echo Lake

organizations.description_en: In Story 4 its Rome station works with the Narcotics Bureau, and its Director, Alan Dulles, recommends Kristatos to M as the contact.

story_timeline: 第1篇:未注明年份的5月,某日清晨7点SHAPE通讯兵在圣日耳曼森林D98公路被杀,邦德当晚从巴黎受命调查,4天后清晨在林间空地伏击,次日清晨7点以替身通讯兵身份诱杀杀手并端掉地堡。第2篇:牙买加Content庄园的谋杀发生在伦敦10月会面前约1个月(夏末),邦德10月初在伦敦受M之命,两天后乘周五Comet飞蒙特利尔,经渥太华入境加拿大,徒步越境至佛蒙特Echo Lake,次日清晨至上午完成复仇,随后带朱迪返回加拿大。第3篇:总督在拿骚晚宴后向邦德讲述往事,故事本身跨越约20年:马斯特斯在尼日利亚任职、乘帝国航空航班结识空姐罗达、婚后调百慕大、妻子出轨Tattersall、被弃后马斯特斯以一年冷漠分居报复并离婚,罗达辗转至牙买加金斯敦Blue Hills酒店,最终嫁给加拿大富商哈维·米勒——晚宴上坐在邦德身边的米勒夫人正是罗达本人。第4篇:10月,M命邦德赴罗马调查海洛因走私,邦德在罗马与Kristatos接头,当晚在Colomba d'Oro餐厅被Colombo窃听,次日乘中午Laguna快车赴威尼斯,第三天下午3点在Lido的Bagni Alberoni与Lisl Baum会面并遭追杀,被Colombo俘至Colombina号,次日黎明在安科纳以北Santa Maria港突袭阿尔巴尼亚船,击毙Kristatos。第5篇:4月,邦德在塞舌尔马埃岛Belle Anse泻湖猎魔鬼鱼,受M之命来此评估安全形势已约1个月,报告已完成1周;登上Wawekrest号赴Chagrin岛,第2天黎明抵达,当天找到Hildebrand Rarity并以鱼藤酮毒杀整片礁区后取鱼,当晚Krest醉酒虐待妻子,凌晨1点半左右Krest被人把毒鱼塞入口中窒息而死,邦德伪装成坠海事故,次日傍晚返抵维多利亚港。
synopsis_en:
FROM A VIEW TO A KILL: On a May morning a killer disguised as a Royal Corps of Signals dispatch-rider murders SHAPE's weekly courier on the D98 road through the Forest of St Germain and stages it as a robbery. Bond, recalled from Paris, finds the killers' bunker hidden under a rose-covered mound in a forest clearing, where a gipsy caravan has provided cover all winter. Riding the same route as a decoy the next morning, he shoots the gunman dead and takes the other two men alive, with Mary Ann Russell saving his life at the last moment.

FOR YOUR EYES ONLY: In Jamaica, Colonel Timothy Havelock and his wife refuse $500,000 for their 20,000-acre estate, Content, and are shot dead on the orders of Major Gonzales, acting for the ex-Gestapo von Hammerstein. A month later M, who was best man at the Havelocks' wedding in Malta in 1925, orders Bond to kill the murderers himself, since extradition is impossible. Bond crosses from Canada into Vermont and joins forces with the Havelocks' daughter Judy, who has come to Echo Lake with her bow to avenge her parents; together they kill Hammerstein, Gonzales and his two gunmen.

QUANTUM OF SOLACE: After burning two yachts bound for Castro's rebels, Bond dines with the Governor of Nassau, who tells him the story of his former colleague Philip Masters. Masters, a shy colonial officer, married Imperial Airways hostess Rhoda Llewellyn and took her to Bermuda, where she left him openly for the eldest Tattersall boy. When she tried to return, Masters took a cold, calculated revenge: a year of silence, a divided house, £20 a month and a divorce, leaving her a car and a gramophone that were still on hire purchase. From this the Governor derives his Law of the Quantum of Solace — once the basic human consideration between partners reaches zero, the relationship cannot be saved. The woman sitting beside Bond at dinner, Mrs Harvey Miller, is Rhoda herself.

RISICO: Heroin is flooding Britain, and on the Prime Minister's orders Bond goes to Rome, where the American Narcotics Bureau informant Kristatos names the restaurateur Enrico Colombo as the head of the smuggling network and asks Bond to kill him. Colombo, who has recorded the whole conversation on a hidden Grundig tape recorder, lures Bond to Venice, captures him, and proves the opposite: he is a wartime Resistance man and a smuggler of cigarettes, gold and diamonds who never touches drugs, while Kristatos is the real drug chief, moving Soviet opium through Albania to Naples. Together they raid the Albanian ship at Santa Maria, and Bond shoots Kristatos dead as he flees.

THE HILDEBRAND RARITY: In the Seychelles, Bond joins the American millionaire Milton Krest aboard his yacht Wawekrest on a voyage to Chagrin Island to find the Hildebrand Rarity, a six-inch pink-and-black fish of which only one specimen has ever been caught. Krest finds the fish, then poisons the whole reef with five gallons of rotenone to secure it. That night the drunken, abusive Krest is found dead in his deck hammock with a poison fish stuffed into his mouth. Bond cannot tell whether his wife Liz or his friend Fidele Barbey killed him; he fakes a fall overboard and throws the body into the sea.

vehicles.note: 第1篇Mary Ann Russell的破旧黑色轿车

vehicles.note: 第4篇邦德由罗马赴威尼斯的中午快车
